title: MCA V3 e-filing (www.mca.gov.in)

pages.title: SPICe+ Part B, section 1: structure and capital
pages.step: Open section 1 (structure of the company) in the form's step list.

pages.title: SPICe+ Part B, section 2: address of the company
pages.step: Click Next, or open section 2 (address of the company) in the form's step list. Mobile and email OTP verification on this section are yours.

pages.title: SPICe+ Part B, section 4: subscribers
pages.step: Open the subscribers section, and each subscriber's Add/Edit panel, yourself. The agent fills the blocks that are open; save each sub-panel yourself.

pages.title: SPICe+ Part B, section 5: directors
pages.step: Open the directors section, and each director's Add/Edit panel, yourself. The agent fills the blocks that are open; save each sub-panel yourself.

source: Recorder captures of 2026-09-23, consolidated from abdulfarhath7/vcfo_assist at 5e58bcf (extensions/vcfo-assist/portal-data/mca-v3/).
notes: MCA V3 forms are Adobe AEM Adaptive Forms. Each field is a .guideFieldNode carrying a semantic class (proposedname1, din7a, correspondenceaddress_pinCode); recipes find fields by that class and its instance, then by the captured node id, then by label.
The login page loads a devtools blocker (clientlib-devtool.js). VCFO Assist never blocks or works around it; the person uses a normal Chrome and the extension.
The legal review rates attended filling on MCA 'Allowed with conditions' subject to the written CS opinion; until it is recorded this pack stays mock-only.
Part B is a wizard (li.listep sections) with Add/Edit sub-panels for each subscriber and director. Opening a section or a sub-panel is the person's step; the agent fills what is open.
